_note: Input bindings, applied to InputMap at startup by scripts/autoload/bindings.gd. Edit here, never in the Godot editor's Input Map tab — editor-authored actions land in project.godot and stop being reviewable (ADR 0027). Event syntax: 'key:<name>', 'mouse:<left|right|middle|wheel_up|wheel_down>', 'joybutton:<name>', 'joyaxis:<name><+|->'.
_note_wasd: W/A/S/D mean different things depending on what is being flown, so they are bound to several actions at once and each vehicle polls only its own. Riding a missile: W boost (held), S brake (held), A/D dodge (one press, on a cooldown) — ADR 0039. Flying the ship: W throttle up, S throttle down, both held and both persistent, A/D lateral thrusters — ADR 0040. The two never poll in the same frame because the ship stops reading input the moment a missile is launched. The cam_* actions are the sandbox fly-cam's and the fly-cam only exists in sandbox.tscn.
_note_aim: aim_* is the reticle, shared by the missile, by manual ship flight and by the gun station. It was called missile_* until manual flight landed.
_note_turret: G mans the guns exactly as T takes the helm, and the two are peers — the player is at one station or the other, never both. fire_primary/fire_secondary are the turret's own triggers rather than a reuse of 'fire', because 'fire' launches a ridden missile and that only happens from the helm; sharing the binding would make one button mean two things in two views. 1 and 2 switch loadout, which is what makes four weapons cost something to reach across two buttons.
